name: Agricultural Landscape of Southern Öland
description: On the Baltic island of Öland in Sweden, this farming landscape covers more than 56,000 hectares of the island's southern end. Much of it is Stora Alvaret, a nearly 40-kilometre-long limestone plain with thin soil, said to be the largest of its kind in Europe and home to many rare plants. People have farmed and settled here for about 5,000 years.
